# aura-system

> aura-system is an Android parental-control kiosk app: a Knox-style device
> lockdown built for Sri Chaitanya Infinity Meta. Solo Leveling "System"
> themed download site with splash video, feature quests, and APK download.

## What it is

- aura-system turns any Android 9.0+ device into a locked kid-safe kiosk.
- Knox-style lockdown alternative made for Sri Chaitanya Infinity Meta
  student and family devices: only allowed apps are visible, everything
  else is sealed behind a Parent PIN and admin password.
- Per-child login profiles, each with its own app set and session.
- Live screen monitoring, activity log, cloud account sync across devices.
- Free. APK distributed directly from this site.

## Install (for users)

1. Download the APK on the Android device.
2. Open it, allow "Install unknown apps" when asked.
3. Open aura-system, set the Parent PIN, pick allowed apps, start control.
